newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian late rubber weak in slow trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian late rubber weak in slow trading.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices declined further in slow late trading on Wednesday on the back of continued weak U.S. demand, dealers said.
Dealers said March SIR20 offer prices were unchanged at 53.25-53.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan. Offer prices in Padang fell to 52.75 U.S. cents while in Surabaya, levels were unchanged at 53.25.
"The market remains weak because there is not much activity. Continued weak U.S. demand has also undermined the sentiment," said one dealer.
He said buyers also sidelined because they expected prices to decline further in the coming days.
Dealers earlier said buyers turned their attention to Thailand's rubber because of the cheaper prices there.

"But many buyers also believe prices will continue to fall, that's why they take a wait-and-see position. This creates an impression supply is ample, while in fact it is pretty much tight," said another dealer.
Dealers said January high amoniac grade latex was on offer at 2,150 rupiah/kg in Bandung and Tangerang.
